page.layout: One printed page, no text. A central woodcut device (Pegasus above a caduceus, palm and laurel branches, clasped hands and clouds, with the letters W and M-like monograms at the sides) in the middle of the page.
page.notes: Engraving only: a printer's device showing a winged horse (Pegasus) above a caduceus entwined with serpents, flanked by palm and foliage, two monograms at the sides, clasped hands and clouds below. No printed words are legible. The digitiser's watermark "Digitized by Google" at the lower right is not transcribed.
